Youth Cheer

Youth Cheer offers the perfect opportunity for youth to develop self-reliance and self-confidence on an individual level while stressing the importance of teamwork within a cheer squad. Cheerleaders will learn basic skills, chants, cheers, jumps, stunts, & dance while experiencing performances in front of a crowd.

The Youth Cheer season is held during the winter months, in conjunction with our Youth Basketball Season.
Youth Cheer camp is during the summer.
These programs are for youth ages 5 – 15.

Age group eligibility is determined by age as of 9/30/2026. This is so kids will play with others in the same grade level as themselves. Playing UP in age level is an option but you will need to first register in the appropriate age group and then speak to the program director.

6U - Ages 5 & 6

Clarksville
1/5/27 - 6/10/27
VIEW

Introduce your child to the excitement of cheer in a fun, supportive environment! Participants will explore basic cheer motions, chants, jumps, and movement through engaging, age-appropriate activities. Children will have opportunities to build coordination, develop listening skills, practice following directions, and gain confidence while learning to work with others. The focus is on having fun, trying new skills, and building a positive foundation for future cheer experiences.

Participants will:

  • Learn basic cheer motions and simple chants.

  • Practice beginner movements, balance, and coordination.

  • Explore simple routines through music and movement.

  • Build confidence, cooperation, and positive sportsmanship.

8U - Ages 7 & 8

Clarksville
1/5/27 - 6/10/27
VIEW

Help your child build cheer skills while discovering the value of teamwork and perseverance! Participants will develop foundational cheer techniques, including motions, jumps, chants, and simple routines. Through group activities and skill practice, children will work on coordination, timing, memory, and following choreography. This program encourages participants to try new challenges, support their teammates, and celebrate progress in a positive, welcoming environment.

Participants will:

  • Develop cheer motions, basic jumps, and chants.

  • Practice coordination, timing, and movement combinations.

  • Learn and perform simple group routines.

  • Strengthen teamwork, confidence, and sportsmanship.

10U - Ages 9 & 10

Clarksville
1/5/27 - 6/10/27
VIEW

Build on the fundamentals of cheer while developing stronger technique and performance skills! Participants will practice cheer motions, jumps, chants, and coordinated routines while working on timing, precision, and movement transitions. Group activities encourage communication, cooperation, and responsibility as participants learn to contribute to a team. The program provides a supportive space to develop skills, build confidence, and enjoy being part of a group.

Participants will:

  • Refine cheer motions and foundational jumps.

  • Practice chants, routine sequences, and coordinated movements.

  • Develop timing, focus, and performance confidence.

  • Build communication, teamwork, and respect for others.

Clarksville

Participants will practice more coordinated motions, jumps, chants, and routines while working on timing, precision, and performance quality. 15U - Ages 13, 14, & 15

Clarksville
1/5/27 - 6/10/27
VIEW

Grow as a cheerleader while building confidence, leadership, and strong team connections! Participants will work on cheer technique, choreography, coordinated routines, and performance skills suited to their experience and abilities. Practices encourage focus, goal-setting, collaboration, and constructive support among teammates. Whether participants are continuing to develop their skills or building on previous cheer experience, the program offers a welcoming environment to challenge themselves, contribute to the group, and enjoy the spirit of cheer.

Participants will:

  • Refine cheer motions, jumps, choreography, and routine execution.

  • Practice timing, transitions, and coordinated group performance.

  • Build confidence, focus, and personal responsibility.

  • Develop leadership, communication, and positive team spirit.
